title: AHB-to-AXI Bridge Debug
description: Debug burst translation in a buggy AHB-to-AXI bridge: split long AHB INCR bursts at the AXI4 256-transfer limit, check WLAST per AXI burst when W can arrive before AW, keep split addresses contiguous, and flag AHB stimulus that crosses 1KB.

steps.title: Step 1: Reproduce the Split Bug
steps.instructions: Compile `bridge_split_checker.sv` and `testbench.sv` together (top module `tb_top`) and run. Inspect the AXI AW log for the `long_incr_bytes` request: the bridge sends a 300-transfer AHB INCR as one AXI burst, AWLEN wraps to 43, but WLAST arrives on transfer 300. With the checker still unwritten, the run ends in `LAB INCOMPLETE`.

steps.title: Step 2: Complete the Checker
steps.instructions: Open `bridge_split_checker.sv` and implement the five TODOs: the AHB 1KB input check, per-burst WLAST accounting with in-order queues (W may arrive before its AW), the first split length, total W accounting, and AXI address continuity. Rerun: the long requests must fail, and you must be able to say why the total count does not.

steps.title: Step 3: Fix the Split Function
steps.instructions: Replace the body of `choose_buggy_burst_beats()` with the 256-transfer cap shown under "Expected Fix" in the README, then rerun. Every request must now end in `LAB PASS`, and `+define+ILLEGAL_AHB_INPUT` must fail only on the illegal-stimulus check.

steps.title: Step 4: Stress the Handshakes
steps.instructions: Rerun the fixed bridge with `+define+AXI_SLAVE_WAITS_FOR_W`, where the AXI slave raises AWREADY only after it has seen WVALID and stalls WREADY at random. The run must still pass. Then answer the README's debug question on why the bridge's W channel must not wait for AWREADY.
